current_text:
Can't stay asleep? 
 If you wake during the night and struggle to drift back to sleep, this targeted Sleep Oil has been expertly formulated to support uninterrupted, restorative rest.
 Developed using the principles of aromachology —the science of how scent influences the mind and emotions—this luxurious bedtime ritual combines Roman Chamomile, Cornish Lavender and 28 expertly blended essential oils to help calm a restless mind, relax the body and prepare you for a deeper, more restorative night's sleep.
 Unlike diffuser oils or pillow sprays, anatomē's Sensory Point Sleep Oil is applied directly to pulse and sensory points, where body warmth gently releases its botanical aroma throughout your evening routine and into the night. As the fragrance unfolds, it creates a consistent sensory experience that encourages the mind and body to associate the aroma with relaxation and sleep. With regular use, this nightly ritual becomes a familiar cue to unwind and prepare for restorative rest.
 Why it works
 The formulation features a unique triple Lavender complex , combining high-altitude, low-altitude and Cornish Lavender to create a rich, layered aromatic profile that encourages relaxation before sleep.
 Roman Chamomile and German Chamomile are blended alongside 26 complementary essential oils, including Rose Absolute, Blue Tansy, Clary Sage, Melissa and Somali Frankincense. Together, they create a sophisticated botanical blend designed to ease feelings of restlessness and support a calming evening ritual.
 A nightly sleep ritual
 This is more than a sleep oil—it's a sensory bedtime ritual.
 Each evening, applying the oil to your sensory points creates a moment of mindful pause before sleep. As the aroma gently develops on the skin, it becomes part of your nightly wind-down routine, helping signal that the day is ending and it's time to rest. With consistent use, the fragrance becomes a familiar sensory cue, supporting a calmer transition to sleep night after night.
